scope: A2 software increment: standard HTTP/RPC RESTART with same simulated MCU config and explicit replacement failure recovery. A2 and the whole recovery/client batch remain incomplete; no physical printer or target-board acceptance.
verified: Authorized standard POST /printer/restart and WebSocket printer.restart return ok after queued journal admission; device reload starts only after response handoff. A lost handoff does not invoke the device; failed admissions retain the last committed outcome.

The actual host loop retains process server, identity, socket, files and journal. A failed configuration replacement stays queryable, never auto-retries, and can be explicitly retried after repair; the failed receipt remains queryable.

Standard restart opens new sessions with UART leaveBootloader=false. Source four and compiled five ready host generations retain the same two PTY firmware models. Stepper config counts stay [4,0]; no firmware reset or print replay; configuration CRC reuse uses the actual serial handshake.
A preparing job is cancelled, but ignored cancellation must actually drain before a new host attaches; the canonical job receipt is cancelled. Standard restart is refused during maintenance.

Late HTTP request bodies cannot restart a newer generation. Queued duplicates return 409; running duplicates within the same generation share admission. Shutdown during replacement prevents attachment and records failure.

Unconfirmed physical stop, dependency cleanup failure and aggregated partial replacement startup/cleanup failure prohibit retry even when the prior server snapshot is stopped. Query resources remain live.

Final independently compiled/installed packages produce identical manifest hashes for standard restart and concurrent heated printing acceptance. Runtime has PATH=/no-programs and TypeScript loading disabled. The latter exercises print, pause/resume, cancel, retirement window, process recovery, persistent JWT/history, uploads/downloads and ADC fault under concurrent API/subscription load.

sourceRegressions.explanation: The final closure reruns changed control/API and all six standard restart cases, adding one rejected-admission outcome case to the earlier 96-case affected suite.

supersededFailures.cause: Compiled parking assertion demanded exact floating zero. The bounded live trapq position is now required finite and within 1e-12 mm of configured zero; physical motion code and broader precision gates were not changed.

remaining: A2: first-generation failure before a listener exists still exits; a queryable process bootstrap failure path remains to be designed/verified.
A2: the pre-existing recovery journal still has 128 durable receipt capacity and no archival policy; ordinary restarts must not permanently exhaust it.
A2: additional actual fault/shutdown/CRC rejection observability is not proven by these reload tests.
A3: /printer/firmware_restart is not implemented; MCU reset must clear actual config/shutdown and require physical stop and transport capability.
A4: current compiled package has not passed actual Fluidd/Mainsail standard restart/upload/reconnect button flows.
Parameter policy differs from pinned upstream: native restart rejects extra parameters with 400. Legacy generation-owned factories reject standard restart.
These tests do not close known numerical/crash failures, retire remaining Python, switch the default entry/CI/install, prove complete Moonraker, or prove Cycnumbris 500 physical safety/performance.
